description: Get one ad with its creative details. For a DISAPPROVED or WITH_ISSUES ad it also returns reviewFeedback (Meta's rejection reasons: global and placementSpecific lists of policy and reason) and issues (errorCode, errorSummary, errorMessage, level), so you can tell the owner why it is not delivering; null means Meta's reasons could not be read.
name: ads_get_ad
title: Get Ad Details
